package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_framework_performance_template_execute_to_string_then_write: Layer: Framework-specific performance. Flag template rendering to strings before writing to the response writer.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

var pageTmpl = template.Must(template.New("page").Parse("<html><body>{{.Title}}</body></html>"))

func RenderPage(w http.ResponseWriter, data map[string]string) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	pageTmpl.Execute(&buf, data)
	w.Write(buf.Bytes())
}

func RenderFragment(w http.ResponseWriter, item string) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	pageTmpl.Execute(&buf, map[string]string{"Title": item})
	w.Write(buf.Bytes())
}
